# `base/choice-inputs`

The user picks from a known, closed set — checkbox, radio, switch or select.

## Selection

- **Use when:** The user picks from a known, closed set — checkbox, radio, switch or select.
- **Avoid when:** The set is large enough to need filtering, or the values are free text.
- **Consider instead:** `base/combobox`, `base/text-inputs`
- **Stability:** stable.

## Import

```tsx fragment — import-only example
import { CardCheckboxGroup } from "themelia-ui/base/choice-inputs"
import "themelia-ui/base/choice-inputs.css"
```

## Composition

This family composes `base/display`, `base/label`, `base/structure`, `base/tooltip`, `base/typography`.

Application policy—routing, fetching, persistence, permissions, and translation—stays
outside the package and arrives through the public props, callbacks, slots, or accessors below.

### `ChoiceColumns`

Kind: type.

Column cap for card groups. There is no `size` prop: geometry follows `--density-scale`
(styles/FACTORS.md).

### `ChoiceOption`

Kind: interface.

One option shape shared by every choice group — card, list and pill — so they can't drift.

| member | required | type | description / documented default |
| --- | :-: | --- | --- |
| `value` | yes | `TValue` |  |
| `label` | yes | `ReactNode` |  |
| `description` | no | `ReactNode` | Supporting sentence. Card and list groups show it; a pill has no room for one. |
| `icon` | no | `ComponentType<{ className?: string; }> \| ReactNode` | Leading glyph. A Lucide icon, any component taking a className, or a rendered node. |
| `tooltip` | no | `ReactNode` | Detail that doesn't fit the row, shown in a tooltip from an info glyph beside the label.<br>The glyph isn't focusable; the text also becomes the option's accessible description. |
| `disabled` | no | `boolean` |  |

## Preview recipes

Preview route: Checkbox — `/checkbox`

### Checkbox

```tsx fragment — excerpt from the live preview; surrounding values are supplied by the application
<Checkbox label="Checked" defaultChecked />
<Checkbox label="Indeterminate" indeterminate />
```

### Radio group

```tsx fragment — excerpt from the live preview; surrounding values are supplied by the application
<RadioGroup name="shipping">
  <Radio label="Standard" value="standard" defaultChecked />
  <Radio label="Express" value="express" />
</RadioGroup>
```

### Cards

```tsx fragment — excerpt from the live preview; surrounding values are supplied by the application
<CardRadioGroup options={plans} value={plan} onValueChange={setPlan} columns={3} />
```

### Cards, several at once

```tsx fragment — excerpt from the live preview; surrounding values are supplied by the application
<CardCheckboxGroup options={channels} value={selected} onValueChange={setSelected} columns={4} />
```

### List

```tsx fragment — excerpt from the live preview; surrounding values are supplied by the application
<ListRadioGroup options={roles} value={role} onValueChange={setRole} />
```

### Pills

```tsx fragment — excerpt from the live preview; surrounding values are supplied by the application
<PillRadioGroup options={views} value={view} onValueChange={setView} allowClear />
```

### Select

```tsx fragment — excerpt from the live preview; surrounding values are supplied by the application
<Select
  options={countries}
  value={country}
  onValueChange={setCountry}
  allowClear
/>
```

### Switch

```tsx fragment — excerpt from the live preview; surrounding values are supplied by the application
<Switch label="Email notifications" defaultChecked />
```

### Settings rows and feature cards

```tsx fragment — excerpt from the live preview; surrounding values are supplied by the application
<SwitchCard label="Two-factor authentication" icon={ShieldIcon} description="…" />
<ToggleField label="Email notifications" description="…" />
<ToggleField surface="card" kind="checkbox" label="Usage reports" />
```
